original_card.question: Can a changed query demand or caller remove real work while satisfying native chronology and restoration?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

actual_scope: On exact #6833 head, enlarge two explicitly declared coordinate stage-mask contracts to allow mixed left/right idle transport, construct one exact arbitrary-input caller interface, and prove complete favorable-budget obstructions at C=.0033718004755.
scope_change_reason: The recursive-interface assignment was specialized to the newer pending #6833 caller after #6839 closed its two-chain invoice family and #6840 closed pure aligned common-hub arms. The changed hypothesis is stage support and mixed cross-side transport; this is not the older selected-word active-mode injection contract. One evidence-driven pivot from masks (4,4) to (1,2) was used after the first optimistic complete bill lost.
bottleneck_link: Cross-side idle fusion can change both productive target credits and paid ranks. The work verifies actual query conjugation and arbitrary-input diagonal behavior, then rejects both targets with the complete native plus target plus thin-query plus idle bill.
stop_rule: Stop a declared target once its favorable complete interval-capacity budget is strictly negative. No broad mask sweep, native/compiler/outer theorem promotion or new kappa is permitted by a partial operator or optimistic result.

open_questions.question: Can a different stage-mask contract admit mixed cross-side carriers with a favorable complete bill?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The explicit construction proves that crossing the bridge is algebraically possible, but both investigated masks lose even under an optimistic interval-capacity relaxation.
open_questions.first_step: Declare one changed mask contract, derive its target incidence and every common pairing rank, and price all native, target, thin-query and idle terms before attempting a literal caller.

open_questions.blocked_by: A legal source-compatible root and a positive complete budget before further construction.

open_questions.question: When do interval pairing capacities determine a useful paid-cost bound for other commuting stage-mask systems?

open_questions.blocked_by: A stated common-query and fixed-projector contract; interval inequalities alone do not establish simultaneous realizability.
